meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跟着引导完成首次配置,顺畅跑通核心工作流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接触这个工具,想快速知道从哪一步开始。
copy.tagline_en: Walk through first-time setup and get the core workflow running
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're new to this tool and unsure where to begin.

howto.what: 装好后 Claude 会带新用户走一遍 omo 的首次上手流程:先做功能导览,再依次提供配置迁移、历史会话分析、缓存节省估算、记忆记录和 init-deep 建议;其中三个环节需你同意才做。
howto.when: 当新用户提出想开始使用 omo 时触发。它只会自动启动一次,之后可用 `omo --onboard`(或 `senpi --onboard`)唤回。

say.text: 我想开始用 omo,带我上手
say.note: 启动首次上手流程,逐个环节介绍

say.text: 我从 Claude Code 过来,能把原有配置迁过来吗
say.note: 进入迁移环节,先给出方案等你确认

say.text: 能看看我以前那些编码会话吗
say.note: 进入会话考古,再据此估算缓存节省

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs a new omo user's first conversation: a feature tour, then optional setup migration, past-session analysis, caching savings estimates, memory recording, and an init-deep proposal. Three lanes are opt-in.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a new user asks to get started with omo. It auto-starts only once; users can bring it back with `omo --onboard` (or `senpi --onboard`).

say_en.text: I want to get started with omo - walk me through it.
say_en.note: Starts the onboarding flow, lane by lane.

say_en.text: I'm coming from Claude Code; can you migrate my setup?
say_en.note: Shows a migration plan and waits for your yes.

say_en.text: Can you look through my previous coding sessions?
say_en.note: Runs session archaeology, then estimates savings.
